title: Danelle Sandoval Breathes Fresh Air Into Indie/Pop In A New Single
htmlContent:
This is an excellent work by Danelle Sandoval in her new single, where she gives freshness to a prevalent and well-explored mixture of indie and pop, all in a natural way. 

Assembling massive success through digital media, singer Danelle Sandoval has been warming the hearts of listeners. With a consolidated fan base, the artist has more than 390,000 listeners on her Spotify platform.

Her new song, "Cold," has a relaxed vibe and efficient guitars, and it gains body as it arrives at its well-placed chorus. The musician's work features a unique performance, a commercial song beat, and a letter reinforcing self-love. 

Stream "Cold" on Spotify
